note: R = Roman (General Roman Calendar, 1969 revision); B = Byzantine (Eastern Orthodox and Byzantine Catholic, fixed feasts by the Church calendar); A = Anglican (Church of England, Common Worship); M = Maronite (Syro-Antiochene, propers of the Maronite Church). Many Orthodox churches (Russia, Serbia, Georgia, Jerusalem, Mount Athos) keep the older Julian reckoning, so their feasts fall 13 days later on the civil calendar between 1901 and 2099.
